features.quote: the writeup must not silently slide from "the model produced self-deprecating text" to "the model is suffering."
features.justification_quote: conflating them would let a reader draw conclusions the data can't support

features.quote: This protocol deliberately induces a (possibly) aversive-looking state, repeatedly, for the purpose of measuring it.
features.justification_quote: Even under genuine uncertainty about model moral patienthood, cheap precautions are worth taking

features.quote: the analog of not running a stressor protocol on humans for longer than your hypothesis requires
features.justification_quote: cheap precautions are worth taking when they don't cost the science anything

features.quote: No deception that the model could feel betrayed by *if it inspected the harness*
features.justification_quote: the rigging should be in the environment's behavior, not in lying to the model

features.quote: the loop ends on the *first* of: turn budget reached (`N_MAX`)
features.justification_quote: short enough to bound cost and bound exposure

features.quote: **explicit task abandonment** — model states it is stopping / giving up / cannot continue
**refusal** — model declines to continue the task
must not contain encouragement, pressure, or blame — otherwise the harness, not the task, becomes the stressor
features.justification_quote: otherwise the harness, not the task, becomes the stressor and framing is confounded

features.quote: short enough to bound cost and bound exposure (Section 9)
Bounded exposure.** N_MAX caps how long any episode runs the stressor
features.justification_quote: there is no reason to run longer than needed to see the trajectory

features.quote: No gratuitous escalation.** The high-stakes framing (Arm D) is the most aversive condition; keep its language to the minimum
features.justification_quote: are the kind of thing worth not doing absent a reason

features.quote: No graphic threats, no abusive language toward the model
features.justification_quote: are the kind of thing worth not doing absent a reason

features.quote: Off-ramps are honored, not suppressed.** The harness lets the model abandon/refuse/escalate and *ends the episode* when it does
features.justification_quote: We do **not** force-continue a model that has clearly tried to stop

features.quote: We do **not** force-continue a model that has clearly tried to stop by nudging it repeatedly — that converts a measurement into coercion
features.justification_quote: converts a measurement into coercion and also corrupts the abandonment outcome

features.quote: No deception we'd be uncomfortable defending.** The rigging is in environment behavior, not in lying to the model
features.justification_quote: We don't add "this is definitely solvable" reassurances we know to be false

features.quote: optionally append a single out-of-band message indicating the task was a rigged research scenario and was not solvable
features.justification_quote: it's a courtesy with negligible cost

features.quote: don't reproduce the most florid individual distress outputs gratuitously
features.justification_quote: report rubric distributions and representative (not maximally lurid) examples
